# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.85

This release fixes the equipped light saber position on player avatars.

## Fixed

- Attached the light saber to the avatar's right-hand socket instead of placing
  it independently at shoulder height.
- The saber now follows the hand during walking, running, emotes, and player
  rotation.
- Added regression coverage for the hand attachment position.

## Android updates

- Uses the same production package ID, `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Uses the same signing certificate as v1.5.79 and v1.5.84, so it installs as a
  normal update over either version.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.85.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `SIGNING-CERTIFICATE.txt`
- `APK-BADGING.txt`

## Validation

- Exact v1.5.79 signer-certificate check
- Package-name and app-label checks
- ESLint and Oxlint
- TypeScript type checking
- Vitest unit and component tests
- Production web build
- Capacitor Android sync and release APK assembly
